note: Mutants judged equivalent (no test could tell them from the original), recorded by `file:line:col mutator → replacement` as SURVIVORS.md prints them, never by Stryker's unstable ids. Each entry is {"mutant": "<that key>", "original": "<the source text the mutant replaces, as it reads at line:col>", "reason": "<why no test can distinguish it, at least 10 characters>"}; the original pins the key to the code it was judged on, so a key a line shift has moved onto different code is refused (test/stryker-floor.test.ts) instead of excusing another mutant. A recorded mutant leaves the denominator of its group's score; the wave that owns the file records it, after reading the code.

equivalent.reason: With no description the mutant writes `description: undefined` instead of leaving the key out; DocModel declares it optional, and every reader (doc-render's title block and the xlsx writer) reads the value, undefined either way (JSON drops the key).

With no meta.footerNote the mutant writes `meta.footerNote: undefined` instead of leaving the key out; DocModel declares it optional, and every reader (doc-render's footer) reads the value, undefined either way (JSON drops the key).

With no meta.liveUrl the mutant writes `meta.liveUrl: undefined` instead of leaving the key out; DocModel declares it optional, and every reader (doc-render's live QR) reads the value, undefined either way (JSON drops the key).

With no branding the mutant writes `branding: undefined` instead of leaving the key out; DocModel declares it optional, and every reader (doc-render's `model.branding` truthiness checks) reads the value, undefined either way (JSON drops the key).

With no bracket.thirdPlaceId the mutant writes `bracket.thirdPlaceId: undefined` instead of leaving the key out; DocModel declares it optional, and every reader (doc-render's drawBracket) reads the value, undefined either way (JSON drops the key).

With no bracketDe.resetId the mutant writes `bracketDe.resetId: undefined` instead of leaving the key out; DocModel declares it optional, and every reader (doc-render's drawBracket) reads the value, undefined either way (JSON drops the key).
buildTimetable's `mode` only picks keyOf's branch: "" equals neither "per_pitch" nor "per_division", so it takes the same last branch (one unnamed group) as "auto"; mode is read nowhere else.
buildRoster's default only feeds `=== "per_team"`, and "" is as much not "per_team" as "auto" is; the value is read nowhere else.
buildOfficialsRota's default only feeds `=== "per_team"`, and "" is as much not "per_team" as "auto" is; the value is read nowhere else.

Page groups are sorted with localeCompare, so a "" group (auto, or fixtures with no division) always sorts first and its first section is pushed while sections.length is 0: the break's `group !== ""` conjunct never decides it, whatever it compares against.

twoSidedBracket puts the first half of every pre-final round on L and the second half on R, so col 0 holds as many R nodes as L; a centre node sits at col 0 only in a one-round (2-entrant) field, where L counts 0, the mutant 1, and Math.max(1, ·) makes both 1.
